values.value: Copies your Volunteers for Salesforce jobs, shifts, sign-ups and completed hours into BarnCRM Volunteers, keeping which job and shift each belongs to. Your contacts stay the same records. V4S itself is never changed.

[{"key":"pages","text":"Take the V4S sign-up pages off your public site (Setup, Sites, the site's Visualforce pages such as VolunteersJobListingFS and VolunteersSignupFS), and point people to the BarnCRM public sign-up page instead."},{"key":"recurring","text":"In V4S, stop recurring job schedules from making new shifts (Job Recurrence Schedules: clear Schedule End Date or delete them), so shifts are made only in BarnCRM."},{"key":"tabs","text":"Remove the V4S tabs from your apps (Setup, App Manager) and the V4S permission sets from users who no longer need them."},{"key":"uninstall","text":"When you have checked your volunteers in BarnCRM and no report or automation uses V4S any more, uninstall it from Setup, Installed Packages."}]
